pacing.cut_style: Rapid montage of extreme macro product shots intercut with quick face/application close-ups, hard cuts on action with no transitions, front-loaded with several cuts in the first seconds to hook before settling into a demo rhythm

look.grade: Warm, punchy beauty-vlog color grade with saturated reds and skin tones pushed slightly orange, deep contrast in the shadows of the product jar, whites clipped bright on highlights and mist droplets

detail.subject: Extreme close-up framing alternating between a wobbling red-pink jelly serum in a glass jar and a person's face/hand applying or spraying product, cropped tight so skin, mouth, fingers, or product fill most of the frame
detail.lighting: Soft diffuse daylight coming from a window or front-left, mostly shadowless and even, with occasional specular hot spots glinting off the wet jelly and glass surfaces
detail.texture: Glossy, wobbling, semi-translucent jelly with visible air bubbles and light refraction, wet sheen on lips and fingertips, smooth dewy skin, slight video compression softness on darker areas
detail.palette: Saturated cherry-red and hot-pink jelly tones against warm brown and tan skin, soft white and cream backgrounds, pale pink bottle accents
detail.lens: Shallow depth of field macro look with soft-focus edges, slight handheld phone-camera distortion typical of front-facing selfie video, close focal distance exaggerating texture
detail.motion_feel: Cutting driven by product reveal beats and rapid attention-grabbing hook cuts at the start, then settles into short lingering holds timed to voiceover phrases, with tiny handheld jitter and slow push-ins giving a live, tactile demo energy

audio.voice_tone: Upbeat, confident, girl-next-door skincare influencer voiceover with casual conversational energy, slightly breathy excitement on payoff lines

notes: Style mixes ultra-close macro food-like product texture shots (jelly, gloss, wet reflections) with intimate face-framed application shots; captions are burned-in white sans-serif text top and lower-third; branding watermark persistent bottom-left; overall aesthetic is glossy, saturated, appetite-appeal skincare content built for silent autoplay scrolling.
